notes.title: Important Announcement: Astrogon Is Going Free!
notes.content:
Dear Astrogon Community,

We have some very exciting news to share with you today. Since we launched Astrogon , we have been amazed by the support and engagement that you, our community, have shown us. Your feedback and passion for our game have been an incredible source of inspiration.

However, we've realized that we want to share Astrogon with even more players around the world. That's why we have decided to make it completely free starting from Friday, June 16!

This decision was not made lightly. We believe that this change will enable Astrogon to reach a larger audience and create an even bigger and more vibrant community.

For those of you who have already purchased the game, we want to sincerely thank you for your support. We understand that this transition might raise questions and we want you to know that we deeply value your early commitment to our game. Your early adoption helped shape the game and the community we have today, and for that we are profoundly grateful.

We are excited to start this new chapter for Astrogon with all of you. If you have any questions or concerns about this change, please feel free to share them in this thread. Your feedback is very important to us.

Thank you again for your continued support.

See you soon in Astrogon!

Kosmoon Studio Team

notes.title: Update notes for v2.0.2
notes.content:
2.0.2
- auto save every 4 minutes in editor mode (can be disabled)
- full gamepad support: automatic switch between gamepad and keyboard controls when using one or another (except for edit mode)
- Feature in beta mode: Press "Ctrl + v" in edit mode to paste a level copied from AstroBP (join the discord to know more)
- Using phaser v3.24 for better stability and performance
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Astrogon is now available !
notes.content:
